fullDescription: A passwordless 'magic-link' sign-in page on a soft off-white canvas with a single teal accent: sticky nav, a two-column hero (pitch + benefits) beside a magic-link login card AND a 'Check your inbox' success card, plus Google/SSO social, a 3-step how-it-works, and a dark security stat strip.

structured.summary: A full-width passwordless 'magic-link' sign-in landing page on a soft off-white canvas (#f8fafc) with a single teal accent. A sticky translucent top nav (Halcyon.id magic-stick logo, How it works / Security / Docs / Pricing links, a 'Sign in' link and a teal 'Get started' pill) sits above a two-column hero+login section. The left column is the marketing pitch ('One link. No passwords to forget.' headline, a 'Passwordless by default' shield pill, a 3-item benefit list, and a small avatar trust row); the right column shows BOTH auth states stacked: the login card (magic-stick glyph, 'Welcome back', a single email field, a teal 'Send magic link' button, a 'password instead' fallback, an OR divider, Google + SSO social buttons, and a Terms/Privacy line) and the success / 'Check your inbox' card (floating opened-letter glyph with a check badge, the sent-to email, a 'Your sign-in link is ready' inbox row with an Open button, and Resend / different-email actions). Below the fold: a 3-step 'How it works' section, a dark teal 'Security teams sleep better' stat strip, and a footer.

style.description: Clean, trustworthy modern SaaS auth aesthetic built on a SINGLE teal accent over a soft off-white canvas (#f8fafc) and slate-grey (slate/'ink') neutrals. Inter throughout (weights 400-800), antialiased with optimizeLegibility, tight tracking on extrabold headings. Generous rounding (rounded-3xl cards, rounded-xl controls, rounded-full pills). Depth comes from a soft multi-layer 'card' shadow, a teal-tinted 'btn' shadow, a 'glyph' glow shadow on the logo tiles, an ambient teal mesh (three radial glows), and a faint 56px line grid masked by a center radial fade. A gentle floating animation lifts the success-card glyph.
style.prompt: Use a clean, trustworthy modern SaaS authentication aesthetic anchored on a SINGLE teal accent over a soft off-white canvas. Page background is 'paper' #f8fafc; brand teal ramp is 50 #f0fdfa, 100 #ccfbf1, 200 #99f6e4, 300 #5eead4, 500 #14b8a6, 600 #0d9488, 700 #0f766e (the primary brand fill, used flat on logo tiles / CTA / links), 800 #115e59, 900 #134e4a; neutral 'ink' (slate) ramp is 50 #f8fafc, 100 #f1f5f9, 200 #e2e8f0, 300 #cbd5e1, 400 #94a3b8, 500 #64748b, 600 #475569, 700 #334155, 800 #1e293b, 900 #0f172a (body text is ink-900 #0f172a, secondary text ink-500 #64748b, muted ink-400 #94a3b8). Typeface is Inter (variable, weights 400-800) loaded from Google Fonts; headings are extrabold with tight tracking, body is relaxed-leading 14-17px. Keep teal as a flat color (#0f766e), NOT a gradient. Named shadows: card = '0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04), 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(15,23,42,0.10), 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(15,118,110,0.06)'; btn = '0 1px 2px rgba(15,118,110,0.30), 0 8px 20px -6px rgba(15,118,110,0.45)'; glyph = '0 10px 30px -8px rgba(15,118,110,0.45)'. Background 'mesh' = three radial teal glows: radial-gradient(1100px 520px at 88% -8%, rgba(15,118,110,0.10), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(880px 480px at 6% 8%, rgba(20,184,166,0.08), transparent 55%), radial-gradient(700px 700px at 50% 120%, rgba(15,118,110,0.06), transparent 60%). A faint line grid overlays it: 56px squares of rgba(15,23,42,0.035) lines, masked by radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%, black, transparent 78%). Cards are white, rounded-3xl, with an ink-200/80 border (the success card uses a teal-700/20 border). Inputs use a 'field' shell: ink-200 border on ink-50/60 fill, rounded-xl, that on focus-within turns its border #0f766e with a 4px rgba(15,118,110,0.12) ring. The logo/CTA glyphs have a '.glyph-glow' radial halo (radial-gradient(circle, rgba(15,118,110,0.22), transparent 68%)). A 'floaty' keyframe (translateY 0 to -6px, 5s ease-in-out infinite) lifts the success glyph. Smooth color transitions on links and buttons (CTA darkens to teal-800 and scales to 0.99 on active).

layout_and_structure.description: A sticky full-bleed top nav above a hero+login main, then three stacked sections (How it works, Security strip, footer). The hero main is a relative 'mesh' background with a masked grid overlay; inside, a max-w-6xl section is a CSS grid that on desktop (lg) splits into a 1.05fr marketing column and a 380-440px auth column, collapsing to a single column on mobile. The auth column stacks the login card and the success card. Below: a white 'How it works' section with a centered intro and a 3-up step grid, a dark teal full-bleed stat strip, and a paper footer.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (top-0, z-50) with a 1px ink-200/70 bottom border, paper/80 background and backdrop-blur-xl. Inner row is mx-auto max-w-6xl, h-16, px-6, items spaced between. Left: a 32px teal-700 rounded-lg logo tile (shadow-glyph) holding a white solar:magic-stick-3-bold icon, next to a 15px bold 'Halcyon' wordmark in ink-900 with a teal-700 '.id' suffix. Center (hidden below md): ghost nav links How it works / Security / Docs / Pricing in 14px medium ink-600, hover ink-900. Right: a 'Sign in' text link (hidden on small screens, ink-700) and a rounded-full teal-700 'Get started' button (px-4 py-2, 14px semibold white, shadow-btn, hover teal-800).

A relative main with the 'mesh' teal radial-glow background and overflow-hidden, plus a pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 layer painting the faint 56px grid masked by a center radial fade. Inside it, a relative mx-auto max-w-6xl section, px-6, py-20 (lg:py-28), as a grid that is items-center gap-16 and on lg becomes grid-cols-[1.05fr_minmax(380px,440px)].

A max-w-xl column: a rounded-full teal pill 'Passwordless by default' (teal-50 bg, teal-700/20 border, teal-800 text, a solar:shield-check-bold icon). Below, a 2.7rem/3.4rem extrabold tight-tracking headline 'One link.
No passwords to forget.' with 'No passwords' colored teal-700. A 1.05rem ink-500 sub-paragraph about dropping your email for a secure sign-in link. Then a space-y-3.5 benefit list of 3 items, each a teal-100 rounded-full icon chip (solar:bolt-bold, solar:lock-keyhole-minimalistic-bold, solar:devices-bold) with a bold ink-900 lead phrase + ink-700 detail ('Instant access', 'Nothing to phish', 'Any device'). At the bottom, a trust row: three -space-x-2 overlapping 28px avatar circles (teal-700 'A', teal-600 'M', ink-800 'K', each ring-2 ring-paper) next to 'Trusted by 12,000+ teams' in 13px ink-400.

A white rounded-3xl card, ink-200/80 border, shadow-card, p-8 (sm:p-9), sitting over a blurred -inset-6 teal-700/5 glow. Centered header: a 56px teal-700 rounded-2xl glyph tile (shadow-glyph + .glyph-glow halo) with a white solar:magic-stick-3-bold icon, a 1.65rem extrabold 'Welcome back' heading, and a 14.5px ink-500 'New here? Create an account' line (the link teal-700). Form: a single labelled email field using the 'field' shell (ink-200 border, ink-50/60 fill, rounded-xl, px-3.5 py-3) with a leading solar:letter-linear icon and a prefilled 'alex@company.com' value; a full-width teal-700 'Send magic link' button (rounded-xl, py-3.5, 15px semibold white, shadow-btn, leading solar:magic-stick-3-bold icon, hover teal-800 active scale-0.99); and a subtle 'Sign in with a password instead' ghost button. Then an 'OR' divider (two ink-200 hairlines flanking 12px tracked-widest ink-400 'OR'), a 2-col grid of bordered white social buttons (Google with logos:google-icon, SSO with solar:buildings-2-bold), and a centered 12.5px ink-400 'By continuing you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy' line with underlined links.

A second white rounded-3xl card below the login card (mt-6), with a teal-700/20 border and shadow-card, p-8 (sm:p-9). Top-left a 'SUCCESS STATE' label: 11.5px bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] teal-700 with a teal-500 dot. Centered: a floating (.floaty) 64px teal-50 rounded-2xl glyph (teal-700/15 ring, .glyph-glow halo) holding a 34px solar:letter-opened-bold-duotone icon, with a teal-700 check badge (solar:check-read-linear, ring-4 ring-white) pinned to its top-right. A 1.65rem extrabold 'Check your inbox' heading and an ink-500 sub naming the sent-to email 'alex@company.com' and the 10-minute expiry. A full-width inbox row: ink-200 border on ink-50/70 fill, rounded-xl, holding a white-tile solar:inbox-line-linear icon, a truncating 'Your sign-in link is ready' / 'Sent just now · no-reply@halcyon.id' two-line block, and a small teal-700 'Open' button on the right. Below, a 13px ink-500 line with teal 'Resend link' and ink 'Use a different email' actions.

A white section with ink-200/70 top+bottom borders, mx-auto max-w-6xl, px-6 py-20. Centered intro: a 12.5px bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] teal-700 eyebrow 'How it works', a 2rem extrabold 'Sign in three taps deep' heading, and an ink-500 sub. Below, a gap-6 md:grid-cols-3 grid of 3 step cards: each is a paper-fill rounded-2xl card, ink-200/80 border, p-7, with a faint '01/02/03' number in the top-right, an 11px teal-700 rounded-xl icon tile (solar:pen-new-square-bold, solar:letter-bold, solar:login-3-bold), a bold heading ('Enter your email', 'Open the link', "You're in") and an ink-500 detail. Cards lift (-translate-y-1) and get a teal-700/30 border + card shadow on hover.

A full-bleed dark ink-900 (#0f172a) section, mx-auto max-w-6xl, px-6 py-16, as a lg:grid-cols-[1fr_auto] grid. Left: a 1.7rem extrabold white 'Security teams sleep better' heading and an ink-300 paragraph about cutting the password attack surface. Right: a flex-wrap gap-8 row of three big stats, each a 2.2rem extrabold teal-300 number ('10min', '1x', '0') over a 13px ink-400 label (Link expiry / Single use / Passwords stored).

A paper footer with a 1px ink-200/70 top border, mx-auto max-w-6xl, px-6 py-9, flex-col on mobile and sm:flex-row spaced between: the Halcyon.id logo (small teal-700 magic-stick tile + wordmark) on the left, a 13px ink-400 '© 2026 Halcyon Identity. Passwordless authentication.' line in the center, and Privacy / Terms / Status ghost links (13px ink-500) on the right.

special_ui_components.prompt: Sticky translucent nav (paper/80 + backdrop-blur-xl, ink-200/70 bottom border) with a teal-700 magic-stick logo tile, ghost center links, and a rounded-full teal 'Get started' button.
Teal-700 rounded glyph tiles carrying solar magic-stick icons, lifted by a 'glyph' shadow and a '.glyph-glow' radial halo (used in nav, login card and footer).
Magic-link login card: a single email 'field' shell (leading letter icon, focus-within teal border + 4px teal ring) and a full-width teal 'Send magic link' CTA, with a 'password instead' fallback.
Two explicit auth states shown stacked: the login card AND a labelled 'Success state' / 'Check your inbox' card, so the prompt teaches the full magic-link flow.
Floating success glyph: a teal-50 opened-letter (solar:letter-opened-bold-duotone) tile with a check badge, animated by a 'floaty' keyframe (translateY -6px, 5s loop).
'Your sign-in link is ready' inbox row: a bordered ink-50 row with an inbox-icon tile, a truncating two-line sender block, and a small teal 'Open' button.
OR divider + 2-up social row (Google via logos:google-icon, SSO via solar:buildings-2-bold) of bordered white buttons.
Ambient background system: a teal 'mesh' (three radial glows) plus a faint 56px line grid masked by a center radial fade.
3-up 'How it works' step cards with corner numbers and hover lift; a dark ink-900 stat strip with teal-300 numerals.
Iconify (solar + logos icon sets) loaded via CDN and Inter from Google Fonts; Tailwind via CDN with a custom paper/teal/ink theme and named card/btn/glyph shadows.

structured.special_notes: Single TEAL accent only (the teal ramp, primary #0f766e), kept as a FLAT color (not a gradient), over a soft off-white 'paper' #f8fafc canvas and slate 'ink' neutrals; body ink-900 #0f172a. This is the magic-link / passwordless pattern: the login card's primary action is 'Send magic link' (a single email field, no password by default) with a password fallback, and a second 'Check your inbox' success card teaches the rest of the flow. Preserve the exact field focus treatment (#0f766e border + 4px rgba(15,118,110,0.12) ring) and the named shadows (card/btn/glyph), the teal 'mesh' + masked 56px grid background, the '.glyph-glow' halos and the 'floaty' success-glyph animation. Inter throughout; rounded-3xl cards / rounded-xl controls / rounded-full pills. Icons via Iconify (solar + logos sets). The page reflows to a single column on mobile (the two-column hero stacks, the nav center links + 'Sign in' link hide). No em-dashes in copy.
